description: The declaration 'double average = ;' has no initial value expression, and 'average' is used four more times.
injected_faults: line 6: expression missing after '=' in 'double average = ;'
notes: Root is at the ';' (found token). Cascade: if the declaration is dropped, the four uses of 'average' (lines 10, 11, 12, 13) can become SEM-UNDECLARED-VAR symptoms. gcc: expected expression before ';' token, and nothing else.
